text: たかいこえで　なきながら　とぶ。

structure.jp: たかいこえで　なきながら
structure.en: while crying in a high voice

patterns.name: 〜ながら
patterns.explanation: ながら added to a verb means doing that at the same time as the main action. なきながら とぶ = 'flies while crying out'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing tells you what is used to do the action. たかいこえで = 'in a high voice'.
